verdict.rationale: Pigment documents its own programmatic surfaces: an official MCP server that lets users build and edit Pigment models from Claude, Cursor and Codex, "open APIs" for integration, and an Audit Trail API. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and probes found no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: an explicit API-to-UI parity claim, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec covering modeling/scenarios/permissions/collaboration, independent hands-on corroboration.
